sections.heading: Keyboard Shortcuts
sections.intro: Percepat pekerjaan dengan shortcut keyboard di Scenario Studio.

steps.title: Shortcut Dasar
steps.desc:
{previewHtml:1}
• **Ctrl+Z** — Undo • **Ctrl+Shift+Z** — Redo
• **Ctrl+C** — Copy • **Ctrl+V** — Paste
• **Delete** — Hapus node/grup
• **Space + Drag** — Pan canvas
• **Scroll** — Zoom • **Shift + Klik** — Multi-select

previewHtml.1: Ctrl+ZCtrl+CDelSpace+Drag

steps.title: Tips
steps.desc:
{previewHtml:1}
• Undo sampai 50 langkah ke belakang
• Copy-paste node antar rule
• Multi-select dulu, baru aksi (delete/copy/pindah)
• Space+Drag lebih cepat dari scroll
